An independent reader judged the previous rewrite of this lesson. Fix everything below as well. Each item is as serious as an item under "Fix these".

### Findings

1. Rule L22a (Minor). Problem: The modal question is one four-sentence paragraph. L22a limits paragraphs to one to three short sentences. Split the four contexts into separate paragraphs.
   > Complete each sentence with the modal that fits the stated meaning: "Rosa (can / must) swim well" describes ability. "You (may / must) leave now" gives permission. "Under the rule, staff (must / might) wear IDs" states a requirement. "It (might / must) rain" states only a possibility.
